title: Carbon Capture Isn't Real
summary: Adam Something gives a short, sarcastic argument that carbon capture does not live up to its promises. He says the energy it uses would be better spent replacing fossil sources directly.
why: HN commenters cite it to argue carbon capture is a distraction from stopping emissions at the source.

quote.text: 100 times out of 100, you would rather just stop the emissions at the source by making the emitter use the green energy.
